description: Read the paragraph formatting of text, paragraph by paragraph: indents and spacing, alignment, justification, hyphenation, keep options, rules, borders, shading, span and split columns, drop caps and nested styles (Paragraph panel and its menu). Distances are mm, line weights points

groups.description: Which groups of settings to read (default: all)

maxParagraphs.description: Read at most this many paragraphs

target.description: Which text to act on. Give storyIds (get_document_stories), frameIds (text frame ids from list_page_items), or selection: true; optionally narrow to a range of paragraphs

frameIds.description: Text frames, by page item id: the text in each frame

paragraphs.description: Only these paragraphs of each text (0-based)

count.description: How many paragraphs (default: to the end)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

wholeStory.description: Widen frames and selected text to their whole stories

name: get_paragraph_formatting
title: Get Paragraph Formatting
